title: Results register
intro: One section per row of `research/results/MANIFEST.md`, grouped by the hypothesis it serves. Every value below is read from the committed results file at the key path beside it, and every file hashes to its MANIFEST sha256, or the register is not written.

H1's live runs, the first that can decide a hypothesis, are scheduled for 1 to 8 December 2026; `docs/log/2026-11-28-rr-milestone-all-rows-reproduce.md` records that every row reproduces on main's code before them.

groups.title: H1. Enforcement beats instruction
groups.needs: The `prereg-v1` tag, once the eight pre-tag conditions at the head of the pre-registration hold: among them the label audit's agreement written into the Benchmarks section, the smoke run and B1 passing on M1 (condition 4), the programme-wide spend cap in billed dollars or the operator's credit check (condition 7), and the Zenodo deposit of the tagged commit (condition 8). Then the live runs of `research/configs/h1-gatemem.json` and `research/configs/h1-mem-inv.json` on M1, scheduled for 1 to 8 December 2026, then `make h1-table` and `make h1-figure` (card X4). No `research/results/h1-table.json` exists yet.

groups.title: H2. The governance tax has a knee
groups.needs: The live runs its Stopping rule fixes on M1: C1 (no memory) on GateMem and LongMemEval, C2 at medium, and C5 at strict, medium and permissive (`research/configs/h2-longmemeval-c2.json` and `h2-longmemeval-c5-medium.json` among them). Only GateMem's C2 and C5 at medium are H1's sessions; its C5 at strict and permissive and its C1 are run for H2. MERIT's arcs run once card B7 counts them. No utility or violation number exists yet.

groups.title: H3. Lints recover part of the governance loss
groups.needs: Card L3's live variance pilot (`research/configs/l3-pilot.json`), which settles whether the model or the deterministic tier is primary, H3's live model-lint run (`research/configs/h3-lint-model.json`), the members' audit of the base-item findings, and the C6 and C5 runs on LongMemEval. No recovery number exists yet.

groups.title: H4. The plane is store-, model- and harness-agnostic
groups.needs: GateMem's C5 runs on M2 and M3 at the size the power table sets, beside M1's from H1's run. Store independence is argued by the request-identity check, not tested, and the harness claim is stated as untested.

groups.title: H5. Governed procedural memory is net positive
groups.needs: Its prerequisites are drafted and proposed, not registered (card H5P); the tau2-bench harness card, the induction runs and replay validation come before any run. No `research/results/h5-*` file exists.

results.prereg: #### U6. The paired fault-injection arm, for H3 (not scheduled)
results.title: Paired fault injection over LongMemEval
results.question: When deletion, temporal-supersession and missing-metadata faults corrupt the memory states of the pinned S split's 500 questions, written as card B5 writes them, at the projection or in the log, how often does the read change, how often does the plane's own enforcement restore it, and do the deterministic lints or the log's hash chain see the fault?
results.note: Card X18's check of proposal U6, which is not registered (the lead registered U7 only): a proof of concept that supports H3 and is not H3's test, measuring state recovery, not H3's utility recovery. Model-free. Every column is fixed by the fault's shape (the result's limits): projection faults recover by replay by construction, and the lints never rewrite. Verification catches an edit that does not re-chain the log; a re-chained log reads UNSIGNED, as the controls do, unless a checkpoint is held outside the database.
